1ST-10TH GEN: Turn ignition to ON. Locate small cap near selector base on console. Pry off.
Insert key or thin flathead. Press firmly downward. Press brake. Move to N.

neutral: Apply parking brake.
Connect jump pack to battery — under hood, driver side.

vehicles.notes: Manual trans: no shift lock — depress clutch.

vehicles.trans: 6-speed auto (2016-2020 EX/EX-L trims) OR ZF 9HP 9-speed (2016-2022 Touring/Elite/Black Edition trims; all 2021-2022)
vehicles.slot: ZF 9HP: slot on the RIGHT SIDE or FRONT-RIGHT of the selector housing — use a PHYSICAL KEY (not a flathead) or dedicated ZF override tool. The slot is small and recessed — requires more force than typical overrides.
shift: CHECK TRIM: 2016-2020 EX/EX-L = 6-speed (standard cap/flathead method). Touring/Elite/2021-2022 = ZF 9HP (procedure below).
Turn ignition to ON.
ZF 9HP TRANSMISSION: RESTORE 12V POWER FIRST — jump pack strongly recommended.
Connect jump pack to battery under the hood. Use AGM-compatible pack.
Once powered, press brake and shift to N normally.
WITHOUT POWER — mechanical override:
Locate the override slot on the RIGHT SIDE or FRONT-RIGHT of the selector housing.
Insert your physical IGNITION KEY (not a flathead) into the slot.
Apply FIRM, steady downward pressure — ZF 9HP requires more force than typical.
While maintaining pressure, press brake and move selector to N.
Hold pressure for up to 10 seconds if initial attempt fails.
neutral: Apply parking brake.
Connect jump pack to battery — under the hood.
Once 12V power is restored, press brake and shift to N normally.
The physical key inside the key fob is required for the mechanical override — always carry a spare key.
vehicles.notes: 3rd gen Pilot key fob contains a hidden physical key — use this as the tool for the shift lock slot. ZF 9HP: jump pack preferred.
vehicles.warn: AWD — FLATBED PREFERRED. If wheel-lift must be used, dollies required on free-rolling axle.

knownIssues.title: Physical Key from Fob Is the Override Tool
knownIssues.detail: The 3rd gen Pilot (2016-2022) shift lock slot requires a thin key to actuate. The override tool is the PHYSICAL KEY hidden inside the key fob — pop it out using the release button on the fob. Operators without this key or who don't know about it cannot complete the override without improvising a thin tool.

battery.warnings: AGM battery. ZF 9HP: must restore power before shifting for reliable operation.

vehicles.slot: ELECTRONIC SELECTOR — 10-speed Honda 10AT. Restore 12V power first. Once powered, press brake and shift to N normally. Without power: open hood, remove intake snorkel, locate transmission shaft — turn shaft with open-end wrench to release parking pawl.
shift: RESTORE 12V POWER FIRST — strongly recommended.
Connect jump pack under hood. Once powered, press brake and move electronic selector to N.
WITHOUT POWER — 10AT mechanical method:
Open hood. Remove the intake snorkel/air box for access.
Locate the park release shaft on the 10AT transmission.
Turn the shaft counterclockwise with an open-end wrench to release parking pawl.
Confirm vehicle rolls freely before proceeding.
neutral: Apply parking brake.
Connect jump pack — under hood. Restore 12V power first.
Once powered, press brake and select N normally on the electronic selector.
Without power: 10AT shaft method — requires hood access, intake removal, wrench.
FLATBED RECOMMENDED if power cannot be restored quickly.
vehicles.warn: AWD — FLATBED PREFERRED. If wheel-lift must be used, dollies required on free-rolling axle.

vehicles.trans: 9-speed ZF 9HP (2018-2019 LX/EX/EX-L trims) OR 10-speed Honda 10AT (2018-2019 Touring/Elite, and ALL 2020-2024)
vehicles.slot: SHIFT-BY-WIRE: no traditional cap/slot. 9-SPEED ZF 9HP (2018-2019 LX/EX/EX-L): restore 12V power first strongly preferred. 10-SPEED 10AT (2018-2019 Touring/Elite, 2020-2024 all): restore 12V power — without front cover and intake removal, mechanical override is extremely difficult. FLATBED STRONGLY RECOMMENDED if power cannot be restored.
shift: Turn ignition to ON.
ZF 9HP: RESTORE 12V POWER FIRST — jump pack strongly recommended.
Connect jump pack to battery under the hood.
Once powered, press brake and shift normally.
WITHOUT POWER:
Locate the override slot near the BASE of the selector on console.
Insert key or flathead. Press firmly and hold.
Press brake and move to N.
ZF 9HP may require firm sustained pressure.
neutral: Apply parking brake.
ZF 9HP STRONGLY RECOMMENDED: Connect jump pack to battery — Under hood.
The ZF 9HP is very difficult to shift without 12V power — jumping the battery first is the most reliable method.
Once powered, press brake and shift normally.
If using mechanical slot: a dedicated ZF 9HP override tool (~$50 online) is more reliable than a key.
vehicles.notes: ZF 9HP: use jump pack or special tool. Do not force shift without power.
vehicles.warn: Do not force shift without power — ZF 9HP is sensitive to improper manual shifting.
vehicles.towMethod: Lift from front — front (drive) wheels in the air, or flatbed. Wheel-lift max: 35 mph, 50 miles — flatbed preferred for longer distances.
towNotes: FWD: lift from front (front/drive wheels in the air) freely. If rear-lift is not possible, place wheel dollies under the REAR wheels and tow front-first.

knownIssues.title: ZF 9HP Requires Power or Special Tool
knownIssues.detail: The 5th gen Odyssey uses a ZF 9HP 9-speed transmission that requires 12V power to shift to neutral reliably. The manual override slot is difficult without power. A dedicated ZF 9HP override tool (~$50 from dealer tool suppliers) is the most reliable mechanical method.

knownIssues.title: Do Not Force the Shift Without Power
knownIssues.detail: Forcing the ZF 9HP transmission to neutral without power risks damaging the transmission's park pawl and internal components. Jump the battery first whenever possible.

knownIssues.title: 10-Speed 10AT Has No Accessible Mechanical Override
knownIssues.detail: 2018-2019 Touring/Elite and all 2020-2024 Odyssey use Honda's 10AT. To put it in neutral without power requires removing the front cover and intake tube — impractical roadside. RESTORE 12V POWER FIRST. If power cannot be restored: FLATBED.

battery.warnings: AGM battery. ZF 9HP: restore power for most reliable shift.

knownIssues.title: Cannot Shift to Neutral Without 12V Power
knownIssues.detail: Honda officially confirmed that the 3rd gen Insight e-CVT hybrid CANNOT be shifted to neutral without battery power on most units. The manual slot override does not function without power on this model. ALWAYS jump the 12V battery first. If no power source is available, use vehicle dollies rather than attempting to force the drivetrain.

vehicles.trans: 5-speed automatic (1st gen 2006-2014); 6-speed automatic (2nd gen 2017-2019); 9-speed ZF 9HP (2nd gen 2020+)
vehicles.slot: 1ST GEN (2006-2014): small cap near gear selector base — pry off, insert flathead, press down. 2ND GEN (2017+) ZF 9HP / SHIFT-BY-WIRE: NO CABIN CAP OR SLOT. Requires Honda special tool 07AAA-TZ3A100 (park lock release) OR restore 12V power first. NO 2015-2016 RIDGELINE EXISTS — production gap between generations.
shift: IDENTIFY GENERATION: 1st gen (2006-2014) or 2nd gen (2017+).
1ST GEN (2006-2014): Turn ignition to ON. Locate cap near selector base. Pry off.
Insert flathead. Press down. Press brake. Move to N.
2ND GEN (2017+) — SHIFT BY WIRE — NO CABIN OVERRIDE:
RESTORE 12V POWER FIRST — strongly recommended.
Connect jump pack under hood. Once powered, press brake and shift to N normally.
WITHOUT POWER: Honda special tool 07AAA-TZ3A100 (park lock release) required.
Tool threads onto a shaft on the ZF 9HP transmission — keeps parking pawl disengaged.
Available on eBay ~$50-$200 or from Honda dealerships. OEM part: 07AAA-TZ3A100.
DO NOT start engine with tool installed.
neutral: Apply parking brake and chock wheels.
1ST GEN (2006-2014): connect jump pack under hood. Use cap/flathead method above.
2ND GEN (2017+): RESTORE 12V POWER FIRST — this is the primary and easiest method.
Connect jump pack under hood. Once powered, press brake and move selector to N.
WITHOUT POWER (2nd gen): Honda tool 07AAA-TZ3A100 required — or FLATBED.
AWD (i-VTM4, standard on all Ridgelines): FLATBED ONLY — AWD cannot be disabled.
vehicles.notes: 1st gen (2006-2014): conventional AWD — flatbed only. 2nd gen (2017+): i-VTM4 AWD — flatbed only. 2020+ Ridgeline has ZF 9HP 9-speed — same override complications as Pilot/Odyssey.
vehicles.warn: AWD — FLATBED PREFERRED. If wheel-lift must be used, dollies required on free-rolling axle.
vehicles.towMethod: FLATBED ONLY — AWD cannot be disabled. If no flatbed available, use wheel-lift with dollies on free-rolling axle.
towNotes: FULL-TIME AWD: Cannot disengage AWD. Flatbed is the safest method. If using wheel-lift, dollies MUST be used on the free-rolling axle to prevent driveline damage.

knownIssues.title: 2nd Gen (2017+) — Shift-By-Wire, No Cabin Override, Special Tool Required
knownIssues.detail: 2017+ Ridgeline with ZF 9HP is shift-by-wire with NO mechanical cabin connection. Dead battery = cannot shift without Honda tool 07AAA-TZ3A100. Restore 12V power first. If power cannot be restored, the tool or a flatbed is required. DO NOT attempt to drag the vehicle.

knownIssues.title: AWD Cannot Be Disabled — Flatbed Only
knownIssues.detail: All Ridgelines are AWD (i-VTM4). AWD cannot be disabled. Flatbed only for towing.
